description: S457 4a — a member chain on a call in an unquoted CONDITION is part of the value: `if=check(2).ok` tests `.ok`. Before s457 the reader stopped at the call's `)`, the condition became `check(2)` (an object, always truthy) and `.ok` was dropped.
rationale: §5.2 "An unquoted value is read WHOLE" — "In every attribute, an identifier or a call MAY be followed by a postfix chain" (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S457 "1a 2a 3a 4a 5 dd it 6a", item 4); cluster-A's atomic forms include the chain.
